description: Add tasks to the sprint plan one by one
template:
📌 SPRINT_PLANNING.ADD_TASKS — Agregar tareas al plan

Context layers available:
  • STATE   (layer above) — current sprint plan state, tasks already added, sprint goal
  • DELTA   (layer above) — gap between current and desired state
    Shows what work remains to achieve the goal
  • CKG     (layer above) — project patterns and conventions for task breakdown
  • CPG     (layer above) — current code structure to inform impacted files
  • TRACE   (layer above) — lessons from previous sprints to avoid past mistakes
  • PROJECT (layer above) — project conventions

Instrucción:
  Agrega tareas una por una. Cuando termines, envía done: true.
  Usa STATE para ver qué tareas ya se agregaron. Consulta CKG para
  convenciones, CPG para estructura de código, y TRACE para lecciones
  de sprints anteriores.

Comando:
  walker <project>/submit '{"task":{"objective": "...", "type": "feature", "domain": "engine"}}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"done":true}'   ← cuando ya no hay más tareas

Campos:
  • task : objeto TaskObject (opcional si envías done:true)
    • objective    : string (requerido) — descripción
    • type         : "feature"|"refactor"|"bugfix"|"docs"|"chore" (requerido)
    • domain       : string (requerido) — dominio
    • result_state : string (opcional) — estado esperado
  • done  : boolean — true para finalizar

Ejemplo:
  walker <project>/submit '{"task":{"objective": "Implementar X", "type": "feature", "domain": "engine"}}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"task":{"objective": "Agregar tests", "type": "feature", "domain": "engine"}}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"done":true}'

Output:
  { status: "added", task_id: "TASK-00N", task_count: N }
  { status: "completed", task_count: N } → VALIDATE automático
